name: Dala horse
about: The Dala horse is a painted wooden horse from Dalarna, a traditional Swedish craft region. It is one of Sweden's best-known symbols.
tip: Check that it is made in Sweden and hand-painted.

name: Salty liquorice candy
about: Liquorice is a classic Swedish sweet, and salty liquorice is especially popular in Sweden. Lakritsroten is a shop dedicated to it.
tip: Choose a Swedish-made brand. Salty liquorice has a strong taste, so check whether you like it first.

name: Orrefors glassware
about: Orrefors is a well-known Swedish glass maker from the Småland region. Its crystal pieces are prized design objects.
